mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees under overcast skies near Harriet Park. The Waning Gibbous moon is out, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, we will unfortunately not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona continues to coordinate with AECOM for engineering services, with regular reports available online. Additionally, WisDOT is hosting public meetings on November 18 and 19 to discuss the US 18/151 Corridor Study, featuring initial designs and seeking community feedback.

We have a busy schedule! Today you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, plus the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat. Later this week, visit the Dane County Farmer's Market on October 31 and enjoy trivia nights on November 4.
Regarding local activity, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by for a scoop.
